name: effective-delivery
description: Effective software delivery through backend-neutral issue reads, direct dependency evidence, PR follow-through, optimized GitHub Actions workflow graphs, and structured CI observation.

metadata.dailyDriver: Install alongside git-ci-operations when agents must read GitHub or Jira issue dependencies, publish pull requests, repair GitHub Actions, and wait for delivery evidence.
metadata.notFor: Local-only Git changes, generic implementation TDD, language-specific semantic review, issue mutation, or an issue backend outside the declared facade capabilities.
metadata.scope: Backend-neutral issue reads, direct blocker maps, pull-request lifecycle, GitHub Actions triage and optimization, workflow-graph proof, releases, structured CI evidence, and quiet event-driven waiting.
